sourceLoss.container: LOST WITH THE SOURCE. A container node holds only a title and upstream URL.
sourceLoss.referencedItem: METADATA SURVIVES, BYTES DO NOT. A referenced item keeps its node and its folio-dublin-core/v1 record.
sourceLoss.materializedItem: THE ARCHIVAL COPY SURVIVES. A materialized item's bytes are held in `library/` with a recorded sha256 verified by `check:materialized-fixity`, alongside its qualified Dublin Core (`folio-dublin-core/v1`) record and CC BY 4.0 licence record.
